artboards.title: 02 · Live analysis — stepper, not a log

annotations.text: Warm editorial shell (#F7F6F2) for the brief; near-black production stage (#0A0A0A) from analysis onward. Type: Instrument Serif for creative language, system sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for evidence.

P0 — every score now carries a benchmark (median of this run's analogue set), an evidence count, and a recommendation strip that says which treatment to pursue and why. 54.2 alone meant nothing to a first-time reader.
P0 — the scene caption sits in the document flow beneath the frame, not floated over it. In the shipped build a fixed player bar cut the caption in half. Frames are real output from a live run.
P0 — replaces the card that showed N/A, a 0-evidence count and a "storyboard below" CTA at the same time. The review flagged that combination as reading like a crash rather than an honest limit.
